name: Koinobori Sky Bridge
description: Giant colorful carp streamers form a bridge across a green valley under spring skies.
prompt: A single joyful culture-inspired landscape: hundreds of giant colorful carp windsocks stream across a deep green valley, their fabric rippling in the wind like a bridge of fish, cherry blossoms on hillsides, distant mountains, bright blue sky with soft clouds, children watching from a hill, festival atmosphere, vibrant and detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: A bridge made of wind, color, and wishes. 🎏💨
